meta.purpose: Memberikan arahan teknis untuk stabilisasi dan pengembangan Doclinc secara bertahap dengan fokus hanya pada repository Doclinc. Sistem host/launcher eksternal berada di luar scope pengerjaan dan tidak boleh dimodifikasi, diasumsikan, atau disentuh dari repository ini.
important_note: Dokumen ini untuk arahan teknis internal pengembangan Doclinc.
Fokus hanya pada codebase Doclinc yang tersedia di repository.
Jangan memasukkan credential, token, secret, data pasien asli, atau informasi sensitif ke repository.
Jangan membuat perubahan, asumsi, endpoint, atau instruksi yang membutuhkan modifikasi sistem host/launcher eksternal.
Dokumentasi publik, laporan client, commit message, dan README harus hanya berisi informasi teknis yang perlu dan aman dibagikan.
revision_focus: Memperjelas batas scope: repository ini hanya Doclinc, bukan sistem host/launcher eksternal.
Menghapus instruksi yang mengharuskan perubahan pada sistem host/launcher eksternal.
Menjadikan integrasi eksternal hanya sebagai kontrak Doclinc-side adapter opsional.
Mempertahankan rencana LiveKit untuk voice/video call.
Mempertahankan rencana LeafletJS untuk realtime kunjungan dokter ke pasien.
Mempertahankan rencana penggantian Firebase dengan komponen Doclinc-side: MariaDB/MySQL, Redis/WebSocket, LiveKit, dan storage adapter.

project.name: Doclinc / Doklinc
project.parent_system: External host application, out of repository scope
project.current_role: Aplikasi layanan kesehatan/konsultasi mandiri pada repository ini. Aplikasi dapat dibuka dari sistem host/launcher eksternal, tetapi sistem eksternal tersebut tidak disertakan dan tidak boleh dimodifikasi dalam pekerjaan ini.

current_stack.runtime_context: Aplikasi PHP lama yang perlu distabilkan, dipisahkan dari modul non-kesehatan, dan dimodernisasi bertahap. Scope kerja dibatasi pada Doclinc saja.

short_term: Stabilkan aplikasi existing tanpa rewrite total.
Perbaiki session, cache, logs, base_url, upload security, asset fallback, dan error frontend utama.
Pisahkan konfigurasi dari source code menggunakan environment/server config.
target_direction.mid_term: Pisahkan Doclinc sebagai layanan mandiri dengan kontrak entry/session adapter di sisi Doclinc saja. Jangan membuat perubahan pada sistem host/launcher eksternal. Gunakan MariaDB/MySQL sebagai sumber data utama, WebSocket/Redis untuk realtime event aplikasi, LiveKit untuk voice/video calling, dan LeafletJS untuk peta kunjungan dokter.
target_direction.long_term: Modernisasi bertahap menuju stack yang lebih stabil, disarankan Laravel jika rebuild disetujui, database terpisah, LiveKit Cloud/self-host untuk voice/video calling, storage object-based, Redis, WebSocket, dan deployment terkontrol. Integrasi eksternal tetap berbasis kontrak, bukan perubahan pada repository eksternal.

notes: Domain staging.doclinc.local dipakai melalui hosts file lokal karena DNS resmi doclinc.com belum dapat dipastikan.
Jangan gunakan Let's Encrypt untuk domain lokal.
Gunakan HTTP untuk staging lokal sampai domain resmi tersedia.
Set PHP site di CloudPanel ke PHP 8.1 jika tersedia, atau PHP 8.2 sebagai fallback. Hindari PHP 8.4 untuk CI3 lama.
Port CloudPanel 8443 sudah terbuka sementara. Setelah setup stabil, batasi akses firewall panel ke IP admin bila memungkinkan.

current_state: Branch main dan fix/config-session sudah diarahkan ke baseline bersih yang sama.
File arahan internal lama dan laporan internal yang tidak perlu di repository sudah dihapus dari branch aktif.
Commit history branch utama sudah diringkas menjadi baseline baru.
rules: Jangan commit file arahan internal yang tidak diperlukan runtime.
Jangan commit laporan audit internal ke webroot repository jika berpotensi dilihat pihak luar.
Jangan commit .env, token, server key, credential database, atau data pasien.
Gunakan commit message netral dan teknis.
Jangan menaruh catatan proses kerja yang tidak perlu di README, markdown publik, atau commit message.
Gunakan .gitignore untuk runtime logs/cache/sessions dan file konfigurasi lokal.

non_negotiable_constraints: Jangan rewrite total sebelum mapping fitur, database, flow user, dan risiko selesai.
Jangan mengubah logic kritikal tanpa memahami controller, model, view, dan data flow existing.
Jangan menyimpan credential, token, secret, server key, atau data pasien asli di repository.
Jangan menggunakan data pasien asli untuk development.
Jangan scraping PCare web sebagai pengganti API.
Jangan menghapus Firebase file/dependency secara membabi buta sebelum inventory fungsi selesai.
Jangan mengganti nama input form existing sembarangan karena backend lama mungkin bergantung pada nama field tersebut.
Jangan mencampur ulang Doclinc dengan database/app lain seperti modul ustadz atau fitur non-kesehatan.
Jangan membuat endpoint dengan user_id mentah di query string sebagai mekanisme login/SSO.
Jangan menganggap WebRTC sebagai pengganti Firebase secara total; WebRTC hanya untuk audio/video/media realtime.
Jangan memakai password database lama atau credential yang pernah muncul di log/chat sebagai credential aktif.
Jangan menyimpan LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, map provider key, webhook secret, atau secret integrasi apapun di repository atau frontend.
Jangan membuat token LiveKit dari frontend; token harus dibuat oleh backend/service internal.
Jangan membuat room call dari parameter frontend tanpa validasi konsultasi dan participant di backend.
Jangan mengandalkan public OpenStreetMap tile server untuk production traffic.
Jangan melacak lokasi dokter/pasien di luar sesi kunjungan aktif yang sah.
Jangan menyimpan riwayat lokasi detail selamanya; wajib ada retention/purge policy.
Jangan mengubah, membuat asumsi, atau menulis instruksi yang membutuhkan akses/perubahan pada sistem host/launcher eksternal.
Jangan menjadikan sistem host/launcher eksternal sebagai dependency wajib untuk menjalankan staging Doclinc.
Jika entry dari aplikasi eksternal dibutuhkan di masa depan, implementasikan hanya adapter/contract di sisi Doclinc dan mock/stub untuk development.
Pertahankan login/session existing Doclinc untuk staging/fallback selama belum ada kontrak entry resmi.

development_principles.strategy: Incremental stabilization first, then modular separation, then modernization.
code_style: Prefer readable, conservative fixes over clever rewrites.
Use escaping for user/database output in views.
Log errors server-side; do not echo debug SQL, stack trace, or raw exception to users.
Keep runtime folders writable by site user without using chmod 777.
Do not let upload/media folders execute PHP or scripts.
testing_expectation: After every change, test login/SSO flow, role routing, key pages, form submit, asset loading, upload flow, and mobile responsive layout.
Check browser console and network tab for 404/400/500/JS errors.
Check PHP logs after critical flow.

frontend_runtime.likely_cause: Default profile asset tidak tersedia atau fallback path salah.
frontend_runtime.suggested_fix: Sediakan asset fallback di assets/doclinc/img/default-profile.png dan update view agar fallback aman.

frontend_runtime.likely_cause: HTML string kemungkinan masuk ke URL/src/href karena echo data tidak aman atau variable view salah.
frontend_runtime.suggested_fix: Cari output yang membentuk src/href/action dari data database. Gunakan escaping, validasi variable, dan fallback.

frontend_runtime.likely_cause: Firebase messaging lama masih dipanggil, sedangkan file/path tidak cocok atau Firebase akan ditinggalkan.
frontend_runtime.suggested_fix: Inventory file Firebase dulu, lalu ganti dengan backend notification + WebSocket/internal notification flow secara bertahap.

frontend_runtime.symptom: Google Maps JS loaded without loading=async
frontend_runtime.likely_cause: Script Google Maps dipanggil langsung tanpa async/defer/loading async.
frontend_runtime.suggested_fix: Rapikan script loading jika fitur maps masih dipakai.

architecture: Doclinc masih tercampur dengan codebase/database lama.
Ada indikasi database/codebase bercampur dengan app lain.
Session, base_url, upload path, dan runtime folder perlu distabilkan.
Firebase dependency lama harus dipetakan sebelum dihapus.
Database config lama masih berisiko karena credential pernah berada di source/config. Credential aktif harus diganti dan dipindah ke env/server config.
runtime: CloudPanel site harus memakai PHP 8.1/8.2 untuk kompatibilitas awal CI3.
Folder application/cache, application/logs, application/cache/sessions, uploads, serta folder runtime admin_menu harus writable oleh site user.
Document root berisi file yang tidak perlu publik harus diblokir via Nginx/site config atau dipindahkan keluar webroot.

recommended_target_architecture.concept: Doclinc menjadi layanan kesehatan mandiri. Sistem host/launcher eksternal hanya dianggap sebagai caller/consumer opsional dan berada di luar repository. Semua pekerjaan harus fokus pada backend, frontend, database, realtime, call, map, storage, dan security Doclinc.
diagram_text: -> Optional signed entry token or context handoff, only if contract exists
-> No code changes from this repository
-> WebSocket for active app realtime events
-> LeafletJS map for doctor visit tracking
-> Validate Doclinc session or optional external entry token adapter
-> Manage consultation, call, visit, notification, and audit data
-> OSM-compatible tile provider / paid tile / self-host tiles

recommended_long_term_stack.backend: Laravel atau service architecture bertahap dari CI3 existing
recommended_long_term_stack.frontend: Laravel Blade/Inertia Vue/React atau web responsive sesuai kebutuhan Doclinc.
recommended_long_term_stack.database_preferred_for_new_build: PostgreSQL jika rebuild penuh disetujui dan migrasi matang
recommended_long_term_stack.database_realistic_existing: MariaDB/MySQL untuk stabilisasi dan fase transisi
recommended_long_term_stack.voice_video_calling: LiveKit Cloud untuk percepatan awal atau self-host LiveKit untuk kontrol production
recommended_long_term_stack.storage: Local storage sementara, lalu MinIO/S3-compatible/object storage
recommended_long_term_stack.deployment: Docker/Nginx reverse proxy atau VM/service terpisah sesuai kesiapan tim

short_term_stack_while_existing_ci3.app_realtime_server: Node.js Socket.IO service terpisah untuk notification/presence/tracking events
short_term_stack_while_existing_ci3.voice_video_calling: LiveKit client + backend token endpoint/service internal
short_term_stack_while_existing_ci3.location_tracking: Backend location endpoint + Redis + WebSocket + MariaDB audit
short_term_stack_while_existing_ci3.external_entry: Optional Doclinc-side adapter/stub only; no external repository changes.

firebase_removal_plan.important_clarification: Firebase tidak diganti oleh satu komponen tunggal. Auth/session tetap dikelola di sisi Doclinc atau melalui optional external entry adapter jika kontrak tersedia. Database/realtime data pindah ke MariaDB/MySQL + WebSocket/Redis, voice/video WebRTC ke LiveKit, storage ke local/object storage, dan push/background notification harus diputuskan sebagai kontrak terpisah tanpa mengubah sistem eksternal dari repository ini.

replacement_mapping.firebase_auth: Doclinc session/auth existing first, optional external entry adapter on Doclinc side only if contract exists
replacement_mapping.firebase_cloud_messaging: Doclinc notifications table + WebSocket for active sessions; optional external push handoff only if an approved API exists
replacement_mapping.firebase_realtime_database_or_firestore_: MariaDB/MySQL sebagai penyimpanan utama + WebSocket/Redis untuk realtime active-session event
replacement_mapping.firebase_storage: Local storage sementara, lalu MinIO/S3-compatible/object storage
replacement_mapping.firebase_analytics: Internal audit log / Matomo / Plausible jika dibutuhkan

safe_migration_steps: Classify each usage: auth, push, chat, call signaling, storage, analytics.
Pastikan semua data penting tersimpan di MariaDB/MySQL sebelum realtime broadcast.
Tambahkan notifications table dan WebSocket/Redis untuk active-session event.
Tambahkan LiveKit sebagai pengganti WebRTC signaling/media custom untuk voice/video calling.
Tambahkan storage adapter agar upload tidak bergantung pada Firebase Storage.
Jika background push diperlukan, buat interface/adapter Doclinc-side dan dokumentasikan kebutuhan API eksternal tanpa mengubah sistem eksternal.
Disable Firebase frontend registration setelah replacement aktif dan teruji.
Remove Firebase config/secrets dari repo dan env setelah tidak ada dependency runtime.

database_replacement_plan.decision: Gunakan MariaDB/MySQL sebagai database utama Doclinc untuk fase existing/staging. Jangan migrasi ke PostgreSQL saat legacy CI3 belum stabil.
reasoning: Codebase CI3 existing memakai mysqli dan pola query MySQL/MariaDB.
SQL dump existing juga mengikuti MySQL/MariaDB.
Migrasi PostgreSQL sekarang akan menambah risiko query, driver, tipe data, dan behavior SQL.

components.primary_database: MariaDB/MySQL for existing CI3 and staging stability.
components.app_realtime: WebSocket + Redis for notification, presence, chat event fanout, and doctor visit location broadcast.
components.voice_video: LiveKit for voice/video rooms and media transport.
components.location_tracking: Redis for last known location + MariaDB for visit status/checkpoint/audit.
components.file_storage: Local storage first, then MinIO/S3-compatible/object storage.

redis_note: Redis Pub/Sub cocok untuk realtime event ringan.
Jangan jadikan Redis Pub/Sub sebagai satu-satunya penyimpanan chat/notifikasi.
Simpan chat/notifikasi ke MariaDB/MySQL terlebih dahulu agar data tidak hilang ketika user offline atau socket disconnect.
credential_policy: Credential database lama yang pernah muncul di chat/log harus diganti.
Database staging harus memakai user/password baru dari CloudPanel.
application/config/database.php sebaiknya membaca env/server config, bukan menyimpan password langsung.

realtime_and_webrtc.decision: Gunakan LiveKit untuk voice call, video call, room, participant management, WebRTC signaling, dan media SFU. Jangan membangun WebRTC signaling custom dari nol kecuali ada alasan khusus yang disetujui.

deployment_options.staging_fastest: LiveKit Cloud for proof of concept and integration testing.
deployment_options.production_controlled: Self-host LiveKit on separate VM/service with valid domain, trusted TLS, correct UDP/TCP firewall, monitoring, and backup plan.
deployment_options.do_not_do: Jangan menaruh production LiveKit di server CloudPanel yang sama jika traffic nyata mulai masuk tanpa kapasitas/monitoring yang jelas.

backend_responsibilities: Validate active Doclinc/external host application session.
Generate deterministic safe room_name from consultation_id/call_id.
Reject token request from invalid participant.
Create notification/incoming call event for receiver.
Update call status, duration, and event log.
frontend_responsibilities: Request call creation/token from backend only.
Connect to LiveKit room using backend-issued token.
Enable audio-only mode for voice call.
Enable audio+video mode for video call.

enable_only_if: storage encryption and retention are defined
egress service is deployed and monitored
recording_policy.notes: Untuk fase awal simpan call metadata/duration saja, bukan rekaman audio/video.

notification_without_firebase.decision: Firebase Cloud Messaging akan ditinggalkan, sehingga notifikasi harus diganti.

recommended_model.background_or_closed_app: Out of scope until approved external push API exists; document limitation and use polling fallback where acceptable
recommended_model.fallback: Polling endpoint for unread notification/incoming calls, only as temporary fallback

backend_flow: If target user has active Doclinc session, send WebSocket event.
If target user inactive/background, do not assume external push availability; use optional push adapter only when an approved API contract exists.
For incoming call, notification payload references call_id, consultation_id, call_type, and Doclinc deep link/path.
Client opens call screen and requests LiveKit token from backend after validation.
notification_without_firebase.important_risk: LiveKit hanya menangani voice/video room dan tidak bisa membangunkan aplikasi yang tertutup. Background incoming call/notification membutuhkan push provider atau external API yang disetujui, tetapi implementasi eksternal berada di luar scope repository ini.

optional_external_push_payload_contract.title: Konsultasi Baru
optional_external_push_payload_contract.body: Ada konsultasi baru yang perlu ditangani.

short_term: Pastikan uploads tidak dapat mengeksekusi PHP/script.
Gunakan MIME detection dan allowed extensions.
mid_term: Pindahkan media konsultasi/chat ke MinIO, S3-compatible object storage, atau GCS.
Database hanya menyimpan metadata file dan object key.
Buat adapter StorageService agar backend tidak bergantung langsung ke satu vendor.

figma_to_development.goal: Implement design from Figma into Doclinc gradually without breaking existing backend logic.
principles: Figma is a visual source of truth, not production code.
Export assets from Figma; do not export whole pages as a single image.
Translate Figma layout to responsive HTML/CSS.
Keep existing PHP form action, input names, loops, and backend data variables unless intentionally refactored.

recommended_asset_structure.assets/doclinc/css/base.css: Global color, typography, reset, CSS variables.
recommended_asset_structure.assets/doclinc/css/components.css: Button, input, card, badge, alert, navbar, chat bubble.

mobile_webview_requirements: input font-size should be at least 16px to avoid mobile zoom issues

bpjs_pcare_and_satusehat_development.decision: Do not depend directly on production PCare/SATUSEHAT during development.

do_not_do: Do not use real patient data.

satusehat_development.recommended: Use SATUSEHAT sandbox when credentials are available. Use mock FHIR/fixtures before credentials are ready.

database_direction.short_term: Keep existing MariaDB/MySQL while stabilizing, but map and isolate Doclinc tables.
database_direction.mid_term: Create separate Doclinc database/schema and migrate only relevant tables/data.
database_direction.long_term: Keep MariaDB/MySQL unless rebuild scope explicitly approves PostgreSQL migration.
must_do: Identify tables from unrelated apps and do not rely on them.
Document relationships: users, dokter/nakes, warga, requests, medicalrecords, chats, notifications, calls, audit logs.
Add migrations only when project structure supports it safely.
Rotate any credential that has ever been exposed in chat/log/source.

auth_session: Validate Doclinc session before protected actions.
If optional external entry token is supported later, validate it only through Doclinc-side adapter and approved contract.
Do not accept role/user identity from plain query params.
Do not require or modify external host application code.
uploads: Block script execution in uploads directory.
output: Avoid raw echo of HTML unless intentionally sanitized.
Do not echo SQL queries or stack traces to users.
secrets: Move secrets to .env or server config.
Rotate database password and integration secret if exposed.
Do not keep GitHub tokens in command history.
health_data: Log key actions without leaking sensitive content unnecessarily.
Avoid committing upload media containing real patient/user data.
webroot: Block access to .git, .env, composer.json, Dockerfile, markdown notes, SQL dumps, logs, and internal folders from public HTTP.
Move SQL dumps and internal docs outside document root where possible.
livekit: Generate LiveKit access token only from backend/service internal.
Never expose LIVEKIT_API_SECRET to frontend or repository.
Validate consultation and participant before issuing token.
Validate webhook signature/secret before processing events.
Do not allow arbitrary room join from user-controlled room name.
location_tracking: Track location only for active assigned doctor visits.
Define retention/purge policy for detailed location logs.
Use HTTPS for production tracking pages.
Prefer external host application/native location bridge for reliable background location.
maps: Restrict map provider tokens by domain/app where possible.
Do not expose unrestricted provider keys.
Do not rely on public tile services for production volume.
Keep map/routing provider credentials in env/server config.

tasks: Confirm repository contains Doclinc only and do not inspect or modify external host/launcher application.
Confirm clean branch/baseline exists.
Confirm backup exists for code and database.
Confirm internal-only files are not in active repository branch.
Confirm .env is ignored.
Rotate any exposed database credential.
Document current staging environment.

recommended_task_sequence.phase: Phase 1 - Stabilize existing CI3 on CloudPanel
tasks: Set CloudPanel site PHP to 8.1 or 8.2.
Fix runtime paths for sessions/cache/logs.
Fix base_url and environment config.
Create CloudPanel database/user for staging.
Import SQL dump using synthetic or sanitized data.
Update database config to read env/server config.
Harden uploads directory.
Fix missing default profile image.
Fix invalid href/src cases such as '<div style=' URL issue.
Remove debug echo/last_query from user-facing responses.
Ensure login/SSO entry does not break existing role redirect.
Create assets/doclinc/css and assets/doclinc/img structure.
Implement base.css, components.css, pages.css.
Redesign login/SSO page first.
Redesign dashboard warga/nakes.
Redesign konsultasi and chat pages.
Test mobile WebView widths and asset loading.
Inventory Firebase usage.
Add notifications table or equivalent backend notification storage.
Add chat_messages table if chat currently depends on transient/realtime-only logic.
Implement WebSocket realtime server for active session events.
Add Redis for event fanout when WebSocket service is ready.
Replace get-notif.js with WebSocket client when ready.
Add Doclinc-side push adapter interface only if approved external API contract exists; otherwise document limitation.
Remove Firebase only after replacement is verified.
Choose LiveKit Cloud or self-host for staging proof of concept.
Add LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY, LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, and webhook secret through env/server config only.
Add consultation_calls and consultation_call_events tables.
Implement backend call creation endpoint.
Implement backend LiveKit token endpoint with participant validation.
Implement incoming call notification flow.
Add LiveKit JS client to call page.
Implement voice-only call mode.
Implement video call mode.
Implement accept/reject/end call actions.
Add LiveKit webhook endpoint and event logging.
Handle permission denied, missed, rejected, ended, failed, reconnecting, and token expired states.
Keep recording disabled until consent, legal, retention, and storage policy are approved.

recommended_task_sequence.phase: Phase 5 - Realtime doctor visit tracking and map replacement
tasks: Use LeafletJS as map rendering library for MVP.
Choose staging tile provider and define attribution.
Do not use public OSM tile server for production traffic.
Add doctor_visits and doctor_visit_location_logs tables.
Implement visit start/arrived/complete/cancel endpoints.
Implement doctor location update endpoint with role and assignment validation.
Store last known doctor location in Redis and important checkpoints in MariaDB.
Broadcast doctor_location_updated event through WebSocket.
Implement patient/admin map screen with realtime moving marker.
Add optional route polyline using OSRM/provider after marker tracking is stable.
Define location log retention/purge policy.
Plan native external host application location bridge for reliable background tracking.
Create adapter interfaces.
Create mock PCare client and fixtures.
Create mock SATUSEHAT/FHIR fixtures.
Add env mode mock/sandbox/production.
Wire Doclinc service/controller to adapter, not direct curl.
Prepare sandbox integration later.
Map all Doclinc features and DB tables.
Prepare Laravel rebuild/refactor plan if approved.
Design separate database schema.
Build SSO, notification, WebSocket, LiveKit, PCare/SATUSEHAT adapters into clean architecture.
Run old and new system in parallel before cutover.
Design production map/routing/location tracking architecture before home-visit rollout.

stabilization: No PHP warnings/notices on main flows.
No missing critical assets on login/dashboard/chat.
No raw SQL/debug output visible to user.
CloudPanel staging opens on http://staging.doclinc.local through local hosts mapping.
repository: No internal development artifacts in active branch.
No credentials or patient data in repository.
Branch main and staging branch point to clean baseline or approved commits.
Commit messages are neutral and technical.
firebase_removed: No Firebase scripts called in browser.
No service worker Firebase registration error.
Voice/video call works through LiveKit, not Firebase signaling.
Background notification strategy documented or integrated via external host application.
database_replacement: Chat messages persist in MariaDB/MySQL before realtime broadcast.
Device/session mapping exists if push integration needs it.
Uploads have database metadata if storage adapter is introduced.
pcare_satusehat_dev: Mock mode works without external credentials.
Sandbox/production credentials can be added through env only.
ui: Existing backend variables/data loops preserved unless intentionally refactored.
livekit_calling: Receiver gets incoming call event/notification while active.
Receiver can accept or reject call.
Both valid participants join the same LiveKit room using backend-issued token.
Invalid participant cannot request token for the room.
Camera on/off works for video call.
Call end/missed/rejected/failed states are stored in database.
LIVEKIT_API_SECRET never appears in frontend, repository, or public logs.
Recording remains disabled unless policy and storage are approved.
doctor_visit_tracking: Doctor can start an assigned active visit.
Doctor location update is accepted only for valid assigned visit.
Patient/admin can see moving doctor marker in realtime.
Unauthorized users cannot subscribe to location stream.
Map works with LeafletJS without Google Maps API dependency.
Production plan does not depend on public OSM tile server for traffic.
Route/ETA is optional and added only through approved provider/OSRM/Mapbox path.
external_entry_boundary: Doclinc can run in staging without external host application code.
Existing Doclinc login/session fallback remains usable for development/staging unless explicitly replaced.
Any future external entry support is implemented as Doclinc-side adapter only.
No task or code requires modifying the external host application repository.
No raw user_id/role query string login is introduced.

work_mode: Keep all work scoped to Doclinc repository only; do not modify external host/launcher application.
Explain risky changes before applying if running interactively.
Never introduce vendor lock-in without explicit reason.
Keep old system working while adding replacement layers.
Do not remove Firebase files until replacement flow is implemented and tested.
Do not change database schema without backup and migration note.
additional_focus_after_v2_1: When implementing call features, use LiveKit token endpoint/server-side secrets only.
When implementing visit tracking, separate map rendering from tile/routing/geocoding providers.
Keep tracking, call, and notification persistence in MariaDB/MySQL before realtime broadcast.
Prefer MVP marker tracking before route/ETA complexity.

livekit_voice_video_calling.decision: Gunakan LiveKit untuk voice call, video call, room, participant management, WebRTC signaling, dan media SFU. Jangan membangun WebRTC signaling custom dari nol kecuali ada alasan khusus yang disetujui.

deployment_options.staging_fastest: LiveKit Cloud for proof of concept and integration testing.
deployment_options.production_controlled: Self-host LiveKit on separate VM/service with valid domain, trusted TLS, correct UDP/TCP firewall, monitoring, and backup plan.
deployment_options.do_not_do: Jangan menaruh production LiveKit di server CloudPanel yang sama jika traffic nyata mulai masuk tanpa kapasitas/monitoring yang jelas.

backend_responsibilities: Generate deterministic safe room_name from consultation_id/call_id.
Reject token request from invalid participant.
Create notification/incoming call event for receiver.
Update call status, duration, and event log.
frontend_responsibilities: Request call creation/token from backend only.
Connect to LiveKit room using backend-issued token.
Enable audio-only mode for voice call.
Enable audio+video mode for video call.

enable_only_if: storage encryption and retention are defined
egress service is deployed and monitored
recording_policy.notes: Untuk fase awal simpan call metadata/duration saja, bukan rekaman audio/video.

realtime_doctor_visit_tracking.decision: Gunakan LeafletJS sebagai library utama untuk rendering peta MVP. Leaflet hanya bertugas menampilkan map, marker, polyline, dan interaksi. Tile, routing, geocoding, reverse geocoding, dan ETA harus disediakan oleh service/provider terpisah.
realtime_doctor_visit_tracking.mapbox_position: Mapbox opsional, bukan wajib. Gunakan Mapbox jika project membutuhkan managed geocoding, directions, map styling, dan delivery production lebih cepat. Hindari Mapbox jika prioritas utama adalah cost control dan low vendor lock-in.

recommended_mvp_stack.tiles: OSM-compatible tile provider for staging/MVP; do not rely on public OSM tile server for production traffic.
recommended_mvp_stack.routing: OSRM/provider route polyline when needed; optional for first MVP.
recommended_mvp_stack.geocoding: Manual coordinate/pin first; provider geocoding later if needed.
recommended_mvp_stack.location_source: Browser Geolocation while WebView/page is active; background tracking must be treated as out of scope unless a native/external bridge contract is separately provided.

tiles: Mapbox if managed map platform is preferred
production_options.tracking: Native/background tracking requires an approved external/native bridge contract and is outside this repository.

doctor_visit_flow: Admin/system assigns doctor visit to consultation.
Doctor opens visit page and taps start visit.
Doctor client sends location every 5-15 seconds while visit is active.
Backend stores last known location in Redis and important checkpoints in MariaDB.
Backend broadcasts doctor_location_updated to authorized patient/admin subscribers.
Patient/admin map updates doctor marker in realtime.

update_interval_recommendation.on_the_way: 5-10 seconds when active foreground tracking is available.
update_interval_recommendation.background: Do not assume WebView background tracking is reliable. Treat background tracking as out of scope unless an approved native/external bridge exists.

security_and_privacy: Doctor can only update location for active assigned visit.
Patient can only subscribe to their own active visit.
Do not expose raw location stream publicly.
Do not keep detailed location logs forever.
Define retention such as 7-30 days for detailed logs unless legal/audit requires otherwise.
Use HTTPS for production because browser location permission requires secure context behavior.
mvp_scope: Optional route polyline after marker tracking is stable.
browser_webview_limitations: Foreground Geolocation API can be used when the page/WebView is active and permission is granted.
Background location tracking is not reliable in a plain WebView/PWA.
Do not add tasks that require modifying external/native app code from this repository.
Document limitation and provide foreground-only MVP first.

map_provider_strategy.decision: LeafletJS first. Mapbox only if managed map/directions/geocoding reliability is required and budget/compliance are approved.
leaflet_limitations: does not provide tiles by itself
does not provide routing by itself
does not provide geocoding by itself
does not provide ETA/traffic by itself
avoid_in_production: public OSM tile server for high traffic
permanent detailed location history without retention policy
recommended_decision_path: Use OSM-compatible paid tile provider or self-hosted tiles before production traffic grows.
Add OSRM/provider routing only after realtime marker tracking is stable.
Consider Mapbox when managed geocoding/directions/style and faster production delivery outweigh cost/vendor lock-in.

external_entry_boundary.decision: Sistem host/launcher eksternal tidak disertakan dalam repository dan tidak menjadi target perubahan. Fokus hanya pada Doclinc.
scope_rules: Do not inspect, modify, refactor, document, or assume code from the external host application.
Do not create tasks that require changes outside the Doclinc repository.
Do not block Doclinc staging on unavailable external entry/SSO implementation.
Keep existing Doclinc login/session fallback for development and staging until a formal entry contract exists.
If external entry is later required, implement only the Doclinc-side consumer endpoint and mock/stub provider for local testing.

token_requirements_if_used.type: JWT signed token or opaque token with introspection endpoint, provided by an approved external contract
must_not_do: Do not trust role from plain query string.
Do not store long-lived token in localStorage unless strictly required and reviewed.
Do not require external application code changes from this repository.
